title: Rounds
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Creative Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Teach the whole song in unison first. Groups stand apart; the teacher brings each group in.

skills.key_step: The child says a round is the same song sung by groups starting at different times, each keeping to its own part, and says its message.

floor.prerequisite: Performs a song with clear words (Grade 2).
floor.question: Why should words be clear when singing?

representations: a two-part round the class knows
steps: Group 1 starts; group 2 starts a line later.
Each group keeps its own part.
contexts: a round at a music festival

board.do: Wait for: after the first line.

misconceptions.ask: In a round, what do the groups sing?
misconceptions.repair: Sing the round slowly with two groups, then each group alone.

misconceptions.ask: Do all groups start a round together?
misconceptions.repair: Point to group 1 to start; point to group 2 after one line.

misconceptions.ask: In a round you hear the other group singing a different line. What do you do?
misconceptions.repair: Practise with a hand over one ear, keeping your own words.

misconceptions.ask: The whole class sings the same words at the same time. Is that a round?
misconceptions.repair: Sing a song in unison, then as a round, and compare.

checks.question: Do groups in a round sing the same song?
What is singing all together at the same time called?
